title: AssessmentDay: Remove both the FAQs and screenshot sections.

change.control: Affiliate landing page includes both FAQs and screenshots.
change.variant: Remove both the FAQs and screenshot sections.

quote: the conversion rate actually dropped by about 3%.
notes: Approximate observed loss; significance is not stated. Removing only FAQs reportedly increased sales 62%, and removing only screenshots increased sales 56%. Do not infer that less content is always better.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
